subject.title: Feature request: auto-update for skills and plugins

question: Should OpenClaw add unattended auto-update for installed ClawHub skills and plugins, and what trust, pinning, rollback, audit, and operator-control policy must gate it?
rationale: The implementation path is feasible, but automation should not choose the product and supply-chain boundary for automatically downloading and applying third-party code.

options.title: Design gated opt-in updater
options.body: Add the feature only after maintainers define a default-off policy with provenance checks, installPolicy integration, pinning/rollback semantics, audit logs, and failure handling.

options.title: Keep explicit updates only
options.body: Leave openclaw skills update and openclaw plugins update as the supported path and document cron or external scheduling for operators who accept the risk.

options.title: Split prerequisites first
options.body: Track signing, rollback, provenance, and skill/plugin update safety as prerequisite work before deciding on background automation.

recommendation.title: Design gated opt-in updater
recommendation.body: Add the feature only after maintainers define a default-off policy with provenance checks, installPolicy integration, pinning/rollback semantics, audit logs, and failure handling.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across package auto-update, ClawHub install flows, and plugin update command boundaries.
